name: Kuchla
notes: The seed is a flat grey disc and it will kill a grown person. It is also, soaked and thrown and soaked again for a fortnight, one of the few things that will settle a palsy -- and the same household keeps it in a sealed jar for both reasons. Canon records the two uses on one plant because that is what the plant is, and the difference between them is entirely a matter of preparation.
journal_prompt: A modest tree with glossy paired leaves and a fruit like a small orange, which children are told about early and pointedly.
